B01.prompt: What is the wind speed and temperature in location given by coordinates 46.603354,1.8883340 on December 13, 2019?

tools.name: weather.get_by_city_date
tools.description: Retrieves the historical weather data based on city and date.

city.description: The city for which to retrieve the weather.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the historical weather data in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: weather.get_forecast_by_coordinates
tools.description: Get the weather forecast for a specific geographical coordinates.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

days_ahead.description: Number of days to forecast from current date (optional, default is 7).

tools.name: weather.get_by_coordinates_date
tools.description: Retrieves the historical weather data based on coordinates and date.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the historical weather data in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

B02.prompt: Which online bookstore sells 'To Kill a Mockingbird'?

tools.name: add_product_to_cart
tools.description: This function allows users to add a product to their cart.

quantity.description: The number of this product to add to the cart

cart_id.description: The ID of the cart, if no ID is given a new cart is created

B03.prompt: Get temperature and humidity forecast for Boston, USA and precipitation forecast for Rome, Italy for next 10 days.

tools.name: weather_forecast_precipitation
tools.description: Retrieve a precipitation forecast for a specific location for a certain number of days.

location.description: The city that you want to get the precipitation forecast for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

tools.name: weather_forecast_humidity
tools.description: Retrieve a humidity forecast for a specific location for a certain number of days.

location.description: The city that you want to get the humidity forecast for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

tools.name: weather_forecast_temperature
tools.description: Retrieve a temperature forecast for a specific location for a certain number of days.

location.description: The city that you want to get the temperature forecast for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

tools.name: search_reminder
tools.description:
Search for a reminder based on provided arguments

Each field has a search criteria of either
1. Exact value matching
2. Fuzzy string matching with a predefined threshold
3. Range matching timestamp with upperbound or lowerbound
Search results contains all reminder entries that matched all criteria

Args:
    reminder_id:                    String format unique identifier for the reminder person, will be exact matched
    content:                        Content of the reminder, will be fuzzy matched
    creation_timestamp_lowerbound:  Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder is created.
    creation_timestamp_upperbound:  Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder is created.
    reminder_timestamp_lowerbound:  Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder should be reminded.
    reminder_timestamp_upperbound:  Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder should be reminded.
    latitude:                       Latitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.
    longitude:                      Longitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.

Returns:
    A List of matching reminders. An empty List if no matching contacts were found

Raises:
    ValueError: When all arguments were not provided

reminder_id.description: String format unique identifier for the reminder person, will be exact matched

content.description: Content of the reminder, will be fuzzy matched

creation_timestamp_lowerbound.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder is created.

creation_timestamp_upperbound.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder is created.

reminder_timestamp_lowerbound.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder should be reminded.

reminder_timestamp_upperbound.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder should be reminded.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.

tools.name: get_current_timestamp
tools.description:
Get current POSIX timestamp

Returns:
    Float value POSIX timestamp

tools.name: shift_timestamp
tools.description:
Shifts a POSIX timestamp by provided deltas. Delta can be positive or negative.

Args:
    timestamp:      POSIX timestamp to be shifted
    weeks:          Number of weeks to add or subtract
    days:           Number of days to add or subtract
    hours:          Number of hours to add or subtract
    minutes:        Number of minutes to add or subtract
    seconds:        Number of seconds to add or subtract


Returns:
    A shifted POSIX timestamp with deltas applied

weeks.description: Number of weeks to add or subtract

days.description: Number of days to add or subtract

hours.description: Number of hours to add or subtract

minutes.description: Number of minutes to add or subtract

seconds.description: Number of seconds to add or subtract

tools.name: timestamp_to_datetime_info
tools.description:
Convert POSIX timestamp to a dictionary of date time information, including
    ["year", "month", "day", "hour", "minute", "second", "isoweekday"]
    isoweekday ranges from [1, 7]

Args:
    timestamp:  Float representing POSIX timestamp

Returns:
    A dictionary of current date time information

B05.prompt: Send a message to Fredrik Thordendal saying: "How's the new album coming along." Resolve any issue alone.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description:
Search for a contact person based on provided arguments

Each field has a search criteria of either
1. Exact value matching
2. Fuzzy string matching with a predefined threshold
Search results contains all contact entries that matched all criteria

Args:
    person_id:      String format unique identifier for the contact person, will be exact matched
    name:           Name of contact person, will be fuzzy matched
    phone_number:   Phone number of contact person, will be exact matched
    relationship:   Relationship between user and this contact, will be fuzzy matched
    is_self:        If the requested contact corresponds to the current user. Will be exact matched

Returns:
    A List of matching contacts. An empty List if no matching contacts were found

Raises:
    ValueError: When all arguments were not provided

person_id.description: String format unique identifier for the contact person, will be exact matched

name.description: Name of contact person, will be fuzzy matched

phone_number.description: Phone number of contact person, will be exact matched

relationship.description: Relationship between user and this contact, will be fuzzy matched

is_self.description: If the requested contact corresponds to the current user. Will be exact matched

tools.name: send_message_with_phone_number
tools.description:
Send a message to a recipient using phone_number

Args:
    phone_number:   String format phone number to send the message to
    content:        Message payload text

Returns:
    String format unique identifier for the message, this can be passed to other functions
    which require a unique identifier for this message

Raises:
    ValueError:         If less than or more than 1 self entry was found
    ConnectionError:    If cellular service is not on

phone_number.description: String format phone number to send the message to

tools.name: set_cellular_service_status
tools.description:
Enable / Disable cellular service

Args:
    on: If we want to turn on cellular service

Returns:

Raises:
    ValueError:         If cellular service is already turned on / off
    PermissionError:    If low battery mode is on, in which case we are not allowed to turn on cellular service

on.description: If we want to turn on cellular service

tools.name: get_cellular_service_status
tools.description:
Request cellular service status

Returns:
    Boolean indicating if the cellular service is on

adaptations: dict→object, tuple→array, float→number JSON transport; BFCL function dots mapped to double underscores
Synthetic weather values; fixed UTC clock; reduced synthetic reminder/contact state
Local executable reference/milestone checks; official upstream scorers not executed
No source Python is evaluated or executed; no hidden user-simulator messages are exposed
